integrity: Complete analytical proof and standalone reproducibility code; no claim of independent certification or of the originality of underlying carbonate equilibria.
scientific_limitations: Exact for ideal carbonate-only mass-action equilibrium and equal-carbonate-alkalinity mixing; not a formula for full seawater buffering, precipitation, gas exchange, unequal-alkalinity pooling or empirical pH. Priority relative to inaccessible historical carbonate-water mixing literature is provisional.
title: A sharp curvature transition for carbonate-only pH under equal-alkalinity mixing
